sections.title: Diagnosis-guided remedy, reconfiguration and action proposals

missing_pieces.duty: S10.1 (pp.395-398): the empirical-coverage argument (faults and combinations never encountered; no data for new products, aircraft or nuclear plants); the two objectives (a reusable model library and problem-solving engines); conceptual-level independence of library and engine; the m:n mapping of systems to formalisms and tasks to inference schemes; the scope statement.

S10.2 (pp.398-403): the displayed fault-detection checks and their well-designed reduction; revision search ordered by deviation (Fig.10.2(a)); the displayed test-generation condition (INP u MODEL1 |= OBS1, INP u MODEL2 |= OBS2, OBS1 u OBS2 inconsistent) with end-of-line testing; the landing-gear FMEA scenario; the ACTIONS/therapy formulation with the Everglades intermediate-goal example; the 10.2.5 conclusion.

S10.3 (pp.403-407): the domain-oriented-model and reusable-library requirements with the copier, on-board and qualitative-FMEA examples; tolerance thresholds and predictor completeness; validity scope examples (superconductivity, transformer overvoltage); Simulink directionality vs Modelica and constraints; 'no function in structure'; the valve whose exogenous set changes; the causal-graph and Bayes-net critique with QPT; value-interval granularity.

S10.4 (pp.407-438): constraint suspension and the windshield-wiper argument; the basic/positive conflict classes of Def.10.4; Def.10.6; the Friedrich et al. physical-impossibility alternative; the Conflict3 reduction by not-broken(HLight); the 10.4.2 design-choice list, incremental computation, conflict-oriented decomposition with its three caveats, on-board elimination of unobservables, Darwiche NNF; all of 10.4.3 (six assumptions, two non-assumptions, the state generalization); formal Defs 10.11 and 10.12 and the [71] sufficiency statement with its conditions; Def.10.13 extension conditions and fault detection/identification/localization readings; Poole's observation form; the guarantee asymmetry between consistency-based and abductive diagnosis; the causal-network and fault-tree critique; the six assumptions revisited for the water case.

S10.5 (pp.438-446): end-of-line testing; Def.10.17 including possibly-discriminating sets; only a subset of a guaranteed test set may need executing; test-input reduction ([73], [49] prime implicants, [80]) and its economics; probe selection as a filter on power-network message bursts [2].

S10.6 (pp.446-454): the operating-region example (three heaters, set point [79]); the control-modification examples (closed-loop to open-loop, wheel-speed approximation); the condition that requires reconfiguration (SD u MA u SA_A u OBS u GOALS inconsistent); the cost referrals [75] and [30] (downtime); generalization to conflict-directed A* [86]; the probe-selection data filter [2].

S10.7 (pp.454-458): the three-reason tractability analysis, including reason 3 (observations reduce the search space) and analogy-based innovative design [82,83]; program structuring from the specification or abstraction; the debugging-results referrals [43,50,51,85] and fault-model testing [27].

S10.8 (pp.458-460): the industrial-potential list; non-component-oriented systems as an issue; the numerical-threshold and numerical-model challenge; a methodology and tools for distributed library production and maintenance.

MP-0 partial: formal persistence and homogeneity with the source's sufficiency result, Def.10.13 extension conditions, the operating-region and control-modification remedy cases, the condition that requires reconfiguration, and the 10.7.1 tractability analysis are still missing.
